name: Reinsurance Manager
description: Leads the Reinsurance value stream, setting annual reinsurance strategy, appetite, and net retentions while directing retrocession structuring. Chairs the reinsurance governance committee, oversees regulatory reporting and coordination with compliance and audit, and manages recovery billing, facultative submission intake, and cedant reporting compliance against notification thresholds.

name: Reinsurance Ops Manager
description: Oversees day-to-day operations across the Reinsurance value stream, running assumed claims loss advice intake, exposure data ingestion, and recovery billing to reinsurers. Administers slip and assumed contract wording workflows, prepares governance committee packs and regulatory reporting, and confirms cedant reporting compliance while distributing management MI to stakeholders.

name: Reinsurance Underwriter
description: Underwrites assumed and retrocession business within the Reinsurance value stream, structuring placements and negotiating slips and assumed contract wordings through to executed, stored agreements. Registers inbound facultative submissions, supports net-retention setting and governance committee reviews, and coordinates regulatory reporting and cedant compliance checks with compliance and audit.

name: Release / Environment Manager
description: Owns go-live readiness within the Product & Delivery value stream, conducting readiness assessments, validating production environments and deployment artifacts, and archiving assessment evidence. Verifies state filing approvals and rating-engine accuracy before launch, confirms support-model and operational readiness, and establishes post-launch monitoring cadence for operational metrics.

name: Release Coordinator
description: Coordinates go-live execution across the Product & Delivery value stream, producing and distributing the go-live day runbook and running the go/no-go review. Confirms operational readiness across teams, verifies state filing approvals and rating-engine accuracy, validates deployment artifacts, and archives readiness evidence and technical documentation for each release.

name: Release Engineer
description: Owns production deployment orchestration for the Technology & Engineering value stream, defining the release calendar around deployment windows and managing release scope and coordination across delivery teams. Executes CD-pipeline deployments and rollback procedures in maintenance windows, and enforces deployment pipeline governance including segregation-of-duties controls and release readiness assessments.

name: Release Train Engineer
description: Coordinates cross-functional delivery from the Program Management Office across Risk, Compliance & Audit, HR & Talent, and Data & AI value streams. Facilitates executive portfolio governance reviews and modernization planning with business-case and funding approval, and supports control framework design and testing, market conduct examination responses, and corrective-action remediation tracking.

name: Renewal Coordinator
description: Coordinates policy operations workload within the Corporate Operations value stream, monitoring real-time workload against staffing, triggering load-balancing for queue imbalances, and forecasting transaction volumes for workforce capacity planning. Manages vendor service performance, remediation plans, and SOC 2 reviews, and assesses regulatory change impact on operations while tracking cost-per-transaction trends.

name: Renewal Underwriter
description: Underwrites renewal business within the Underwriting value stream, revising and re-issuing quotes with negotiated terms and completing policy binding and mid-term endorsement processing. Administers the reinsurance program by screening treaties for retention and submitting bordereaux, monitors portfolio concentration and appetite exceptions, and supports underwriting quality assurance and appetite guideline governance.

name: Report Developer
description: Develops actuarial financial reporting for the Actuarial value stream, constructing loss triangles, screening data for anomalies, and reconciling actuarial balances to the general ledger. Supports prior-year development analysis, GAAP versus statutory reconciliation, internal economic capital modeling and RBC computation, and PML regulatory disclosures on actuarial modeling platforms and the data warehouse.

name: Reserving Actuary
description: Owns reserve setting across the Actuarial value stream, delivering life and annuity statutory valuation under PBR and GAAP LDTI reserving including annual assumption unlocking. Prepares and files the Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum with regulators, manages ceded reserves and reinsurance recoverable collectability provisions, and conducts reserve adequacy and unearned premium reserve reviews.

name: Reserving Analyst
description: Performs reserving analysis within the Actuarial value stream, computing indicated ultimate losses across methods, calculating IBNR, and running deterministic reserve calculations for statutory PBR valuation and GAAP LDTI reserving. Assembles Actuarial Opinion Summary exhibits, supports assumption unlocking and Actuarial Memorandum filings, and assesses reinsurance recoverable collectability for ceded reserve management.

name: Resilience Engineer
description: Owns IT service continuity and cyber resilience within the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, operating the enterprise backup platform with offsite and immutable copies and testing data restoration for critical systems. Sets RTO/RPO targets, defines the annual DR test schedule and runbooks, tests ransomware recovery, and compiles DR evidence for cyber continuity regulatory reporting.
